title: Farce
paragraphs: Returning to the town near Melromarc Castle via the portal, I went to visit the monster merchant.
“Well then, today, we will attempt contact once again. Yes.”
“Please. The Shield Hero seems to have moved to the coastal abandoned village… But, he is with beastmen.”

I believe the older sister of Big Sister’s goal is to find Big Sister. If I were to facilitate Big Sister here, what kind of actions would the older sister of Big Sister take? Once the older sister of Big Sister achieves her goal, I think she will quietly leave. That would mean a betrayal to Father. It would be best to avoid that path.
“I want you to either release the beastmen or wait until they’re gone before I sell the slaves I arrange.”
“Understood. Yes.”

After my meeting with the monster merchant, I greeted the crimson swines in the morning. Ugh… If we don’t hunt today, we’ll definitely be suspected. We spent the rest of the afternoon hunting for the country’s work and leveling up. Thinking about offering experience points to the crimson swines, I felt like my stomach would fall out.
When we returned, there was a somewhat relaxed atmosphere between the older sister of Big Sister and Father. Were they talking about what level they were or something?
“Naofumi-chan, did your level go up?”
“…Yeah.”

I’m not sure why the older sister of Big Sister gives off such a friendly impression. I don’t quite understand her intentions, but it feels similar to when I met the older sister of Big Sister in Zeltbur. She seems to be scheming something, but she doesn’t give off any hints… It’s that kind of atmosphere.
“Then, let’s go drop off the fish in the port town. I’ll carry it too.”
With that, the older sister of Big Sister and Father moved toward the port town.
“Naofumi-chan, you’re so suspicious. You can’t trust big sister that much?”
“I thanked you for earlier, and since then, you haven’t caused me any harm. But, why are you following me so much?”
“Hmm. I don’t know. I just feel like I can’t leave you alone, does that work as a reason?”
“…Yeah, yeah.”
With a somewhat drained expression, Father began to ignore the older sister of Big Sister.
“If you can’t trust big sister that much, should I have her mark you with a slave brand? I wouldn’t mind if big sister gets branded for you, Naofumi-chan.”
“Slave brand?”
The older sister of Big Sister explained to Father what slaves in this world were and how they couldn’t resist.
“Something like that? Then if I ordered you to die…”
“I suppose you could.”
“…Why do you want to be my slave so badly?”
“Maybe because I think I can trust Naofumi-chan? Well, big sister also has her reasons, I say.”
After hearing about the slave mark, Father pondered again. He’s probably thinking that if it’s something he can’t betray, it might be useful to make her an ally.
“I suppose I’ll go ask the slave merchant about this.”
“Oh, I’ll introduce you.”
“I can’t trust anyone you introduce!”

After saying that, Father went off to search for the slave merchant in the port town and asked what the slave mark was, verifying the information. He even slipped money to tavern owners and merchants to gather information. By the time Father finished gathering information, it was already evening.
“It seems it’s true. The demi-humans and beastmen walking through the streets all have the slave mark, so it must be confirmed.”
“Yes.”
“…If you’re being a nuisance, I’ll kill you.”
“Oh dear.”

With a cheerful expression, the older sister of Big Sister chose to become Father’s slave. She asked the slave merchant in the port town for the ritual and became his slave. Of course, the monster merchant subtly swapped places and introduced himself.
“Ah, Naofumi-chan’s love has been engraved, huh?”
With a snap, the slave mark activated, and the older sister of Big Sister leaned back.
“Ah. What’s wrong, Naofumi-chan?”
“…It seems to be working. Stop with that disgusting phrasing.”
“Understood, Naofumi-chan. Well, with this slave mark, I understand that I can’t sneak around and steal things while you’re sleeping, right?”
“…Yeah.”
“Then, should we go back to the village and sleep? You haven’t slept, so it must be tough, right? Come on, I’ll carry you.”
“Stop, that’s creepy! But, well, I agree with sleeping.”
What in the world… The older sister of Big Sister has become Father’s slave. I can’t hand over Big Sister to Father anymore.

What’s the older sister’s goal? She probably realized Father’s true identity and intends to have him help search for Big Sister. It’s more efficient for Father, a human and the Shield Hero, to search for slaves than for the beastman older sister to search herself. A strategist, huh.

But that’s an unnecessary strategy! After that, Father and the older sister of Big Sister started spending more time together. The level is easier to raise near the sea. As for money, as long as the older sister of Big Sister is around, we can manage things fairly easily. Since they weren’t in the village, I used a portal to head to the older sister’s secret base. When I arrived, I found Father and the older sister of Big Sister drinking together. It seems that Father, thinking that with the slave mark, he couldn’t do anything unnecessary, was acting cautiously. While they were rummaging through the warehouse and drinking through the night, I noticed that the older sister’s gaze toward Father had become intense.

Had she already taken the Lurcol fruit? And so, the days passed like this. Ah, as for Big Sister, I’ve been quietly taking proper care of her. I can’t let her remember too much about me, so I’ve left most of the care to others. The innkeeper, having been paid, understands the situation from Big Sister’s circumstances and has been very attentive in looking after her. For now… it seems like I’m buying enough time. As the time for the wave approaches, Father and the others headed to the castle town.
“Naofumi-chan, should we first prepare our equipment for the wave?”
“Yeah, there might be something better than the armor Sadeena prepared.”
With that, Father visited the weapon shop.
“Oh, it’s you, An-chan. It’s been a while. You’ve got some… interesting companions with you.”
“The pushy guy joined on his own… Well, it’s been helpful. Anyway, we’ve gathered some money, so we need to get some equipment.”

The shop hasn’t changed much, but next, they’ll probably be heading to the Dragon’s Hourglass to prepare for the wave. It can’t be helped. Although the older sister of Big Sister is an unsettling factor, I’ll have her do her best as a substitute for Big Sister. If we fail, we’ll take care of Ren or Itsuki. Then, while pretending it’s a coincidence, I brought the Crimson Swine and others along, and we encountered Father. He shoved the older sister of Big Sister and walked toward the plains. After that, it was time to act. The wave arrived. As in the first world, I charged straight for the wave boss, fighting the Dimension Chimera with all my might but holding back. Looking back briefly, it seemed the older sister of Big Sister was unleashing her lightning magic. Father seemed to have fought quite well as well. His level was probably higher than it would have been with Big Sister. After all, the older sister of Big Sister is stronger. Once the wave ended, a victory celebration was held at the castle. There, the Crimson Swine and Kuzu seemed to have made some kind of behind-the-scenes plan and called out to me.
“Bu bu bu, bu bu bu bu, bu bu!”
They probably explained to me that, like in the first world, the older sister of Big Sister, who is near Father, is a slave.
“What?! …I can’t believe it! She was indeed a strange beastman, but to think she was a slave… I can’t forgive this!”
Pretending to be angry, I walked toward Father.
